newsitem.title: USA: Commodore clarifies ASI acquisition impact.
newsitem.headline: Commodore clarifies ASI acquisition impact.

text.p: Commodore Applied Technologies Inc on Wednesday issued a clarification of the financial impact of its acquisition of Advanced Sciences Inc, restating the revenue the deal added to Commodore's 1996 results.

Commodore in announcing the acquisition's completion on September 30 said it "anticipates revenues in excess of $25 million from ASI in 1996." But because ASI's fiscal year ended that day while Commodore is on a calendar year, under accounting rules Commodore recognized $5.0 million in revenue from ASI in the final quarter of 1996.
ASI did have gross revenues of $26.6 million for its 1996 fiscal year, Commodore said.
Commodore shares were trading down 1/4 to 6-3/4 at midday Wednesday.
